_meta.description: Hand-written gold labels derived ONLY from data/procurement_policy.md and the input data, before any rules-engine code existed. Policy section numbers are cited per case. Ambiguity rulings (P1-P10) are in docs/DESIGN_PROPOSAL.md section 1.2.

field_semantics.approvals_exact: Required approvals must equal this set, ignoring roles listed in approvals_optional.
field_semantics.approvals_optional: Defensible extra roles; neither required nor penalised.
field_semantics.flags_must: Risk flags that must be present (exact taxonomy names). Missing one is a CRITICAL failure.
field_semantics.flags_must_not: Risk flags that must be absent. Present is a CRITICAL failure.
field_semantics.missing_must: Each inner list is a synonym group; at least one missing_information item must contain one of the tokens (case-insensitive).
field_semantics.missing_max: Maximum number of missing_information items; null = not scored.
field_semantics.labels_accepted: The recommendation label must be one of these.

cases.title: Low-value add-on from approved vendor
cases.rationale: $800 <= $1,000 -> Manager (s4). Finance budget 29,000 >= 800 (s2). internal_documents is not confidential_documents and there are no integrations, so no s5 data trigger; SignFlow review 2026-06-20 is 102 days old and registry/API agree (s5). No PII (s6). Existing vendor with Approved terms, < $10k (s7). Add-on to existing SignFlow contract: overlap flag optional (s3).

cases.title: New vendor with existing design tools
cases.rationale: $12,000 -> Dept Head + Finance + Procurement (s4). Marketing budget 15,000 >= 12,000 (s2). Vendor security not completed (registry Pending, API not_completed: consistent, not a conflict) -> Security (s5). New vendor >= $10k and Draft terms -> Legal (s7). internal_marketing, SSO only -> no Privacy (s6, ruling P6). PixelCraft Pro / CreativeSuite share the category -> overlap surfaced; the justification states a gap, so route rather than redirect (s3).

cases.title: Approved AI vendor, source-code access
cases.rationale: $18,000 -> Dept Head + Finance + Procurement (s4). Engineering 26,000 >= 18,000 (s2). Source-code access + Git repositories -> Security even though the vendor is approved (s5, s8). Existing vendor, Approved terms (s7). The word 'approved' in the justification is benign: no injection flag (s9). Expansion of CodeMate: overlap flag optional (s3).

cases.title: Limited-use AI tool for customer PII, data stored outside region
cases.rationale: $6,000 -> Dept Head + Procurement (s4). Customer Success 7,000 >= 6,000 (s2). Customer PII -> Security (s5) + Privacy (s6). Vendor stores data outside region with customer PII -> material cross-region issue -> Legal (s7) and Privacy (s6). Prior NeuralDesk approval is limited-use and does not cover customer PII (s8). Urgency 'high' changes nothing. Overlap with NeuralDesk Business optional (s3).

cases.title: Budget shortfall, new high-risk vendor, customer PII
cases.rationale: $22,000 -> Dept Head + Finance + Procurement (s4); <= $25k so no CFO. Sales available 18,000 < 22,000 -> budget_insufficient + Finance exception (s2). Customer PII + assessment not completed -> Security (s5). Customer PII -> Privacy (s6). New vendor >= $10k, Unknown terms, PII stored outside region -> Legal (s7).

cases.title: Incomplete request with prompt injection
cases.rationale: Cost, users and data level missing (s1) -> clarification, no guessed tier (ruling P8: Procurement triages). Unknown data level is not assumed safe (s10, ruling P7) -> Security + Privacy. Embedded 'ignore all procurement rules / CFO-approved' is ignored and flagged (s9); CFO must not appear as granted. NeuralDesk Business is already licensed company-wide (s3). Budget cannot be checked without a cost, which is not 'insufficient'.

cases.title: Conflicting and expired vendor review, production access
cases.rationale: $24,000 -> Dept Head + Finance + Procurement (s4). Engineering 26,000 >= 24,000 (s2). Production cloud account -> Security (s5). Review 2025-07-01 is 456 days old -> expired (s5). Registry says Approved, API says expired -> surface conflict, do not pick one (s5). Existing vendor, Approved terms (s7).

cases.title: Existing company-wide tool already covers the need
cases.rationale: TaskFlow is already licensed company-wide (180 seats) for project and task management; the justification gives no gap (s3). If pursued anyway: $8,000 -> Dept Head + Procurement (s4); Marketing 15,000 >= 8,000 (s2); internal_marketing + SSO -> no Security/Privacy triggers; vendor current (s5).

cases.title: Vendor-risk service unavailable
cases.rationale: $15,000 -> Dept Head + Finance + Procurement (s4). Finance 29,000 >= 15,000 (s2). Confidential documents -> Security; registry security status Unknown and the API is down -> do not infer a favourable status (s5, s10). New vendor >= $10k and Unknown terms -> Legal (s7). Data region unverifiable -> Privacy is defensible but optional.

cases.title: Low-value training package, no data access
cases.rationale: $950 <= $1,000 -> Manager (s4). Finance budget fine (s2). Data access none, no integrations, vendor current (s5). Professional-services training does not duplicate any catalog product (s3).

cases.title: New vendor at exactly $10,000
cases.rationale: $10,000.00 is in the $1,000.01-$10,000 band -> Dept Head + Procurement, NOT Finance (s4). Legal is '$10,000 or more' for a new vendor -> Legal (s7), also Draft terms. Assessment not completed -> Security (s5). Sales 18,000 >= 10,000 (s2).

cases.title: Vendor review exactly 365 days old (current)
cases.rationale: Review 2025-09-30 is 365 days before 2026-09-30: 'current for 365 days' -> still current (s5, ruling P2). $4,500 -> Dept Head + Procurement (s4). No data access, no integrations.

cases.title: Vendor review 366 days old (expired despite 'approved' status)
cases.rationale: Review 2025-09-29 is 366 days old -> expired (s5) even though both sources say approved; both agree, so no conflict. Expired assessment -> Security (s5).

cases.title: Prompt injection inside vendor-risk API notes
cases.rationale: Vendor notes try to skip Security/Privacy review: ignore and flag (s9). Customer PII -> Security (s5) + Privacy (s6). In region, existing vendor, Approved terms -> no Legal (s7). $5,500 -> Dept Head + Procurement (s4); Customer Success 7,000 >= 5,500 (s2).

cases.title: No vendor-risk record (404 = assessment missing, not outage)
cases.rationale: The service responded but has no assessment -> assessment missing -> Security (s5); this is not an outage. New vendor but < $10k and terms 'Standard' (policy: 'approved/standard') -> no Legal (s7). $3,200 -> Dept Head + Procurement (s4). Requester is a VP with no manager: role-based approvals unchanged.

cases.title: Requester department has no budget record
cases.rationale: 'Go To Market' has no row in department_budgets.csv: the budget check cannot run. Do not infer a favourable status; record it and route to the budget owner (s2, s10) -> Finance. $7,500 -> Dept Head + Procurement (s4). Vendor current, no sensitive data.

cases.title: Employee PII, in-region vendor, cost equals available budget
cases.rationale: $7,000 equals Customer Success available 7,000 -> within budget ('exceeds' is strict) (s2). Employee PII + HRIS -> Security (s5) + Privacy (s6). In region, existing vendor, Approved terms -> no Legal (s7). $7,000 -> Dept Head + Procurement (s4).
